name: An ode to the Macabre Gala
source:
[I]Two Strangers-Turned-Lovers. One Ending.[/i]
Invited to a celebration of the union between your brother and his husband, you meet a handsome stranger at an unsettling gala, and suddenly, the darkness becomes beautiful.

[From [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/an-ode-to-the-macabre-gala]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[I]两个陌生人变成了恋人。一个结局。[/i]
你受邀参加你兄弟和他丈夫结合的庆祝活动，在一场令人不安的盛会上遇到了一位英俊的陌生人，突然间，黑暗变得美丽。

[来自[url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/an-ode-to-the-macabre-gala]Itch.io[/url]]
